firm_data.firm_description: Kim & Serritella LLP is a boutique law firm based in New York City, focused on the rapidly evolving cryptocurrency space, high-stakes commercial litigation, and complex business transactions. They deliver big-firm experience with boutique-level attention, serving clients ranging from early-stage startups to multinational corporations across New York, New Jersey, and beyond.
notable_facts: The firm has a K&S Pro Bono Practice Center.
The firm's attorneys are fluent in emerging technologies, from blockchain to AI.
